text: Ken Kaneki is written 金木 研 in Japanese and is the bookish student at the center of the story.
excerpt: After the operation Kaneki develops ghoul-like tendencies and characteristics, and his rationality begins to wane.

text: Touka Kirishima is written 霧嶋 董香 in Japanese and works at the Anteiku cafe.
excerpt: She blends in well with human society and believes that keeping one's ghoul identity is of top most priority.

text: Rize Kamishiro is written 神代 利世 in Japanese and is the ghoul who attacks Kaneki on their date.
excerpt: Rize was a girl with glasses that Ken encountered who tried to eat him after luring him out on a date.

text: Hide Nagachika, whose full name is Hideyoshi, is written 永近 英良 in Japanese and is Kaneki's best friend.
excerpt: He has a sharp intuition, so much so that while Ken tried to keep his ghoul identity hidden from him, Hideyoshi seemed to know something is weird.

text: Yoshimura is written 芳村 in Japanese and is the manager of the Anteiku cafe.
excerpt: He is a very kind and reasonable ghoul that provides aid and food to ghouls that are incapable of hunting on their own.

text: Nishiki Nishio is written 西尾 錦 in Japanese and is a university student who is also a ghoul.
excerpt: He is arrogant and hates it whenever his juniors talk back to him.

text: Hinami Fueguchi is written 笛口 雛実 in Japanese and is a young ghoul living in the 20th ward.
excerpt: Hinami is a 13 to 14-year-old ghoul that came to the 20th ward with her mother after her father was killed by ghoul investigators.

text: Kotaro Amon is written 亜門 鋼太朗 in Japanese and is a Special Class Investigator of the CCG.
excerpt: He has a very strong sense of justice and believes that he must make this "Wrong World" right by killing the ghouls.

text: Akira Mado is written 真戸 暁 in Japanese and is an investigator of the CCG.
excerpt: She is an intelligent woman and seems to be always serious about work and her daily routine in general.

text: Shu Tsukiyama is written 月山 習 in Japanese and is a fashionable ghoul.
excerpt: He is a very powerful, cunning, smug, and fashionable ghoul and was also an acquaintance of Rize.

text: Juzo Suzuya is written 鈴屋 什造 in Japanese and is a young investigator of the CCG.
excerpt: A young boy with an androgynous appearance. He was raised by a ghoul called Big Madam until he was taken in by the CCG.

text: Kisho Arima is written 有馬 貴将 in Japanese and is a Special Class Investigator of the CCG.
excerpt: He is always seen wearing his glasses, with his face kept in an apathetic expression, rarely showing any emotion if not at all.

text: Ayato Kirishima is written 霧嶋 絢都 in Japanese; he is Touka's younger brother and an executive of Aogiri Tree.
excerpt: The youngest Executive of Aogiri, and Tōka's younger brother. He is a troubled and rebellious teenager.

text: Renji Yomo is written 四方 蓮示 in Japanese and is a quiet ghoul connected to Anteiku.
excerpt: Renji is a quiet and reserved ghoul. He is an expert coffee brewer, although he does not work for the shop anymore.

text: Yamori is written 大守 八雲 in Japanese and is an executive of Aogiri Tree.
excerpt: A deranged Executive of Aogiri, he was nicknamed 'Jason' due to his brutality and habit of wearing a hockey mask.

text: Seido Takizawa is written 滝澤 政道 in Japanese and is an investigator of the CCG.
excerpt: He was mortally wounded by Noro, and declared KIA. In Tokyo Ghoul:re, he returns as a major antagonist after being turned into an insane One-Eyed Ghoul.

text: Eto Yoshimura is written 芳村 愛支 in Japanese and leads Aogiri Tree.
excerpt: She enjoys breaking people by picking on their insecurities and according to Sasaki, she lost all hope long ago.

text: Haise Sasaki is written 佐々木 琲世 in Japanese and is a CCG investigator who leads the Quinx Squad.
excerpt: Despite having a new identity, Haise still retains some traits from his former self, like the love for reading and the determination to protect his companions.

text: Toru Mutsuki is written 六月 透 in Japanese and belongs to the Quinx Squad.
excerpt: Tōru struggles to keep his one eyed kakugan under control, much like Kaneki did in the past; he suffers from anemia.

text: Nimura Furuta is written 旧多 二福 in Japanese and is the main antagonist of Tokyo Ghoul:re.
excerpt: The main antagonist of Tokyo Ghoul:re. He was originally Sōta Washū-Furuta, and later known as Nimura Furuta.

text: Kaneki's hair turns white: slowly from chapter 61 in the manga, but all at once in the anime.
excerpt: In the manga at chapter 61, Kaneki's hair slowly changes color from black to white. In the anime, his hair changes instantly

text: By the end of the story Kaneki has taken the title of the One-Eyed King.
excerpt: Anteiku waiter, CCG as Haise Sasaki, then One-Eyed King

text: When steel beams fall on Rize, her organs are moved into Kaneki, which makes him a half-ghoul.
excerpt: Parts of her body are transplanted into Ken after she is struck by fallen iron construction parts.

text: Touka's kagune belongs to the ukaku type and can crackle with lightning.
excerpt: Kagune Type: Ukaku (can produce lightning)

text: Late in the story Touka marries Kaneki, and she is expecting his child.
excerpt: Becomes pregnant with Kaneki's child; they marry.

text: Hide senses that something is off about Kaneki, even though Kaneki tries to hide his ghoul side from him.
excerpt: He has a sharp intuition, so much so that while Ken tried to keep his ghoul identity hidden

text: In the later story Hide takes on a disguise known as the Scarecrow.
